info.headline: Notify NYC - LIRR Disruption - Babylon Branch (MN/BK/QN)
info.description:
Notification issued 11-03-2026 at 07:34 AM.
Due to a person struck by a train, customers should expect delays and possible cancellations at Long Island Rail Road Babylon Branch service in both directions. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info/lirr.
